user.title: Connect Gmail
user.description: Use a Gmail app password, not your normal Google password. Create one on the App passwords page of your Google account (it needs 2-Step Verification). The tracker reads the sender and subject of new emails, opens only the ones that look like shipping mail, and never marks anything as read.

reauth_confirm.title: New app password needed
reauth_confirm.description: Gmail stopped accepting the app password for {email} (this happens when the Google password changes). Create a new app password and enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: Gmail didn't accept that address and app password.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Gmail. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.not_gmail: That account doesn't look like Gmail (no All Mail folder).
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong; check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Gmail account is already being tracked.

data.show_unknown_address: Show packages when the email doesn't say where they're going
data.informed_delivery_is_mine: Always show packages from USPS Informed Delivery

data_description.scan_minutes: How often to look for new shipping emails.
data_description.lookback_days: How far back the first check reads. Gmail keeps deleted mail in Trash for 30 days.
data_description.keep_delivered_days: How long a delivered package is remembered. The card and sensors show a delivery only on its day, but the voice assistant can still answer about it, and "probably delivered" to-do items stay ticked, for this long.
data_description.addresses:
Only show packages going to these addresses. Useful if you share a store account with other households; leave it empty to show every package in your email.

Type each address the usual way, for example **123 Main St, Springfield, IL 62701**, or just a town (**Springfield, IL**) or a name. Amazon emails only show the first name and town, so Amazon packages are matched by town; if another household on the account lives in the same town, put your name in front of your full address: **Jane Doe, 123 Main St, Springfield, IL 62701**.
data_description.show_unknown_address: Many carrier emails (most USPS and UPS updates) don't say where a package is going. On: those packages show. Off: they stay hidden until an email shows they're coming to one of your addresses.
data_description.informed_delivery_is_mine: USPS Informed Delivery only lists packages coming to your own address, so show them even if no other email says where they're going.

error.address_too_short: "{entry}" is too short and would match almost every package. Use a town, a ZIP code or a full address.
error.address_too_long: "{entry}" is too long for an address.
error.address_needs_commas: Can't tell where the street ends and the town starts in "{entry}". Put commas between them, for example 123 Main St, Springfield, IL 62701.
